distribution.narrative: Knížek (2008) described Scolytoplatypus zahradniki from type and paratype material collected in Beijing, Shaanxi and Sichuan, supporting presence in mainland China.

host_note: The paper states that the host plants are unknown. Specimens were found on broken thin stems of an evidently deciduous tree or shrub and the species was inferred to live in broadleaved trees. Because no host taxon was identified, no host is promoted to Current Host Summary.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Scolytoplatypus zahradniki Knížek, 2008.

taxonomic_history.name: Scolytoplatypus zahradniki
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Scolytoplatypus zahradniki Knížek, 2008 is the currently accepted taxon (Scolytinae: Scolytoplatypodini), mapped to pre-existing VSN_5451. The authorship string in integrated taxonomic backbone was corrected from a corrupted encoding to Knížek, 2008.
